content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent PFS assessment method between sections",
      "quote": "Progression will be based on an independent radiologic assessment of disease response per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Section 2.1.2 states PFS is based on 'independent radiologic assessment' while Section 3 states 'blinded independent central review (BICR)'. This inconsistency could lead to confusion in implementation and analysis.",
      "fix": "Harmonize terminology across sections, e.g., use 'blinded independent central review (BICR)' consistently."
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete OS definition in key secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are OS, objective response rate (ORR), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), including change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms (dyspnea, cough, and chest pain), physical functioning, and health related quality of life (QOL).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The OS definition is not fully provided in this section; it is only partially described in a parenthetical. This could lead to ambiguity in the analysis.",
      "fix": "Provide the full OS definition (time from randomization to death from any cause) in this section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Potential ambiguity in PRO endpoint time frame",
      "quote": "change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The phrase 'over time to week 12' is ambiguous; it could mean assessments at multiple time points up to week 12 or a single change from baseline to week 12. This may lead to analysis inconsistencies.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether the endpoint is a longitudinal analysis or a single timepoint change from baseline to week 12."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for prior therapy may be overly restrictive",
      "quote": "Prior treatment must include a platinum-based doublet chemotherapy and checkpoint inhibitor for advanced or metastatic disease, either given as one line of therapy or as individual lines of therapy unless the subject has a medical contraindication to one of the required therapies.",
      "page": 58,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "amendment_risk",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Requiring both platinum-based doublet and checkpoint inhibitor may exclude patients who received only one due to standard practice variations, leading to slow enrollment and potential amendments.",
      "fix": "Consider allowing either platinum-based doublet or checkpoint inhibitor as sufficient, or broaden to 'at least one prior systemic therapy' without specifying both classes."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing safety monitoring for KRAS inhibitor class",
      "quote": "Subject incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events, treatment-related adverse events, changes in vital signs, and clinical laboratory tests.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoints are generic and do not include specific monitoring for known KRAS G12C inhibitor toxicities such as hepatotoxicity, gastrointestinal events, or interstitial lung disease. This could miss important safety signals.",
      "fix": "Add specific safety monitoring for KRAS inhibitor class effects, e.g., liver function tests, GI toxicity assessment, and pulmonary evaluation."
    },
    {
      "title": "Potential inconsistency in PFS censoring for new anti-cancer therapy",
      "quote": "PFS is censored at the date of last evaluable assessment before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "This censoring strategy may introduce bias if new therapy is initiated due to progression, but the primary endpoint definition in Section 2.1.2 does not mention this censoring. This inconsistency could affect analysis.",
      "fix": "Ensure the primary endpoint definition in Section 2.1.2 includes the same censoring rule for new anti-cancer therapy."
    },
    {
      "title": "PRO endpoint may be burdensome for patients",
      "quote": "Change from baseline over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms of: o Dyspnea as measured by a 4-item dyspnea domain from QLQ-C30 and QLQ-LC13 o Cough as measured by QLQ-LC13 o Chest Pain as measured by QLQ-LC13",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Requiring multiple PRO instruments (QLQ-C30 and QLQ-LC13) with multiple subscales may be burdensome for patients with advanced NSCLC, potentially leading to missing data and incomplete assessments.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing the number of PRO assessments or using a single instrument to minimize patient burden."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for KRAS mutation testing may delay enrollment",
      "quote": "Have documentation of KRAS p.G12C mutation confirmed by central testing through the current protocol or have documentation of KRAS p.G12C mutation through Amgen Study 20190294 prior to enrollment.",
      "page": 58,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "amendment_risk",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Requiring central testing confirmation may cause delays in enrollment, especially if local testing is available. This could lead to slow recruitment and potential amendments to allow local testing.",
      "fix": "Allow local testing with central confirmation post-enrollment, or provide a rapid central testing process."
    }
  ]
}
